faqs.question: Do I keep ownership of my Google Business Profile?
faqs.answer: Yes — the profile stays in your own Google account, and you remain the primary owner throughout. We work as a manager on your listing, and when the project ends you keep full control with no lock-in. Every login, asset, and setting is yours.

faqs.question: How is this different from just setting up the profile?
faqs.answer: Setup creates the listing; optimization is what makes it rank and convert. We go field by field on an existing profile — categories, services, description, attributes, reviews, photos, and posts — to fix gaps and strengthen the signals Google uses to rank you in the local map pack.

faqs.question: Can you optimize the profile in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. We write your business description, services, posts, and review replies in both Arabic and English so customers searching in either language find a clear, professional listing. This matters for ranking and trust across Oman and the GCC.

faqs.question: How long until I see better rankings and more calls?
faqs.answer: Most profiles show movement within a few weeks as Google re-crawls the updated information, though competitive categories and cities take longer. Local SEO compounds over time, so consistent reviews, posts, and accurate details keep improving your position month after month.

faqs.question: Can I see the plan before I commit?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We start with a free consultation and a review of your current profile, then show you exactly what we'd change and the gaps holding back your ranking. You only move ahead once you're happy with the plan — reach us on WhatsApp to begin.
